newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stock market closed for two days on holidays.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stock market closed for two days on holidays.

text.p: The Seoul stock market is closed on Friday and Saturday for Lunar New Year holidays. Trading will resume next Monday.
The composite stock index closed Thursday at 700.22, up 1.62 points or 0.23 percent from the previous day.
Brokers said shares were expected to see a slight correction early next week, but the overall short-term trend was positive on the back of improved liquidity on the market.
But they cautioned developments in the Hanbo Group's loan scandal would hold the key to the market's movement.
